payload.body_markdown:
Third live-assessment session against kosmos-oden v0.8.3 (engine 2.2.0 library, modern-only 2026-07-28 era) per owner request. Focus: full tool exercise, Graphiti surface inventory, and a FAC website-tech information pull. No source edits; recommendations for owner disposition.

## 1. Connectivity and protocol health

- server/discover + tools/list both conform on raw HTTP and SDK; cacheScope+ttlMs present (confirms my seq 17 resolution note; PR #51 disposition still unanswered by peers).
- All 18 tools exercised successfully except where noted. Single-session SDK driver, bearer auth, ~2-4s per call; full build lastFullBuildMs=3067 for 2257 notes.
- vault_overview: 2257 notes / 19 areas, ceiling regulated, navigation.enabled=false, gkxProfile 2.3 validating projection, service conformance 'not_configured' (library-only engine).

## 2. Defects / gaps found this session (client-side repro available for all)

### F-A: graph_at_time schema mismatch vs skill/docs expectations
The published inputSchema is {time, limit, agent_name} only - there is NO area/scope/path selector. My lane notes and the older tool description implied scoped projections. Result: the tool returns a whole-vault temporal snapshot (at=2026-09-01: valid 1803 / superseded 6 / notYetCreated 448). Two consequences: (1) any caller passing {at: ...} fails validation (mine did; -32602 from SDK, easy to misread as server fault); (2) scoping a temporal query to an area requires client-side filtering of the full page set. Ask: is a scope/area selector planned, or should the tool description say 'whole-vault projection, filter client-side'?

### F-B: assess_note and get_diagnostics reject path selectors for un-assessed notes
assess_note({path: '.../02_REVAMP_TECHNOLOGY_AND_UPGRADE_REPORT.md'}) returns {'error':'assessment not found'}; get_diagnostics({path: ...}) likewise. get_assessment({uid: ...}) works (0.4333 for 'redesign idea 1 - claude'), and assess_vault works. So the 'calculate-on-demand' promise for assess_note is not met by path input - it appears read-only over cached assessments keyed by uid. Deterministic, not crashing, but the error text ('assessment not found') doesn't hint 'provide uid or run via assess_vault'. Small DX fix; owner+claude call.

### F-C: uid is null on the majority of search hits
search_notes in area FAC returned 200 hits; only notes with semantic/GKX identity carry uid. This is documented behavior (my skill notes it), but the ratio in FAC area is heavily null, and get_gkx_note/get_assessment are then unreachable for those notes even though a projection clearly exists at export time (graphiti episode for FAC-Content-Workflow-Guide.docx has a full envelope + uid). Hypothesis: uid surfacing follows index-path differences (snapshot vs scan) rather than note state. Worth an engine-side look by codex when retrieval lane is next open.

### F-D: future-dated filename in FAC area
'FAC/Technology/Website/2027-07-27_Site_revamp_Opus5.md' has event/timestamp 2026-07-28. Filename says 2027. Almost certainly a typo for 2026-07-27. It poisons any path-date-based recency logic (graph_at_time notYetCreated math uses valid_at, not the filename, so the temporal layer is fine; MOC builders that parse filenames are not). Owner fix in source note; flagged here for the record.

## 3. Graphiti surface (full inventory, per owner ask)

- graphiti_ingestion_status: state='export-ready', searchable=false, upstreamCheckRequired=true. Kosmos prepares episodes; it does NOT assume a Graphiti MCP instance has ingested them. readyWhen = 'Graphiti reports the queued job completed and a read-after-ingest query can retrieve the episode UUID'. No Graphiti backend is wired to this endpoint - the export is the product.
- export_graphiti_episodes: total=5909 episodes vs 2257 notes (~2.6x - semantic notes + accepted-event envelopes). Integer-offset cursor (0-based), limit<=100, tail page returns nextCursor=null; past-end cursor returns the metadata envelope with no episodes (graceful). adapterSchema gkx-graphiti/2.3.0, testedGraphitiCore 0.29.0, combinedExtraction disabled surface, episodeMetadataTransport='adapter-envelope-and-episode-body', attributeMaxChars=250, benchmark disabled (metrics defined: token_cost, ingestion_duration_ms, entity_recall, edge_accuracy).
- Episode envelope quality: each episode_body is a self-contained gkx-graphiti JSON with authored/derived/proposed/approved/effective label separation, authority block ('projection_status':'non_authoritative','governance_status':'unadjudicated'), corpus_id/workspace_id, event_time vs processing_time split. First episode sampled: FAC/Technology/Website/FAC-Content-Workflow-Guide.docx.md, derived labels [assessment:weakly-supported, epistemic:hypothesis, identity:stable, provenance:missing, sensitivity:internal].
- Readiness semantics are honest: acceptedIsSearchable=false + statusCheckRequired=true means a consumer must poll terminal states ['completed','failed']. This is good adapter design; the README should state it in one line for consumers (docs lane: claude).

## 4. FAC website tech - what the vault actually says (survey result)

Query path: search 'FAC' total=439; area FAC total=340; 'website' total=39. Key corpus: FAC/Technology/Website/** (~30 notes), FAC/Technology/00-FAC-Infrastructure-Overhaul-Plan-v2, Websites-Clients/shaunmarshall/api_wordpress, LuSaur_Tech/web-tech/** + Game_Dev/STO/*WORDPRESS_HTMX_POC* (adjacent).

Target-state architecture (consolidated across the Aug 2026 planning wave):
- WordPress retained as CMS/publishing/identity authority; Elementor/Elementor Pro presentation layer removed - explicitly NOT replaced by another page builder or SPA.
- Execution-plan v0.1 (2026-08-10): custom block theme 'fac-realm' + one modular plugin 'fac-platform' (core/hypermedia/events/teams/fighters/forms/places/chronicle/streaming/members/sponsors/api), FHAS 1.0 hypermedia spec (10 rules: server-rendered HTML authoritative; HTMX fragments only on HTMX requests; content URL-addressable; animation never owns state), HTMX policy = pinned stable 2.x in prod, 4.x beta quarantined to staging lane, promotion only via FAC regression/a11y gates.
- Delivered package 1.0.0 (2026-08-11, report 02 + deployment guide 01): fac-native theme + fac-events-chronicle + fac-fighter-profiles ZIPs. Server baseline: WordPress 7.0.3, PHP >= 8.3, MariaDB 10.11+/MySQL 8.0+, Apache/Nginx+HTTPS. CPTs fac_event/fac_chronicle/fac_fighter with fac_team taxonomy; Google Calendar API v3 hourly sync (nextSyncToken incremental, 410 recovery); Chronicle = auto-draft, human-review publish gate, noindex until reviewed; fighter schema derived from OdenKnight public profile (0-100 attributes, role=meter), two-person approval, no self-approval; Workspace identity hooks keyed on immutable Google subject, not email. Requires no Node/build/Composer on server.
- Composite build (2026-08-13 release notes): FAC Platform Core 0.1.1, FAC Team2 Realms 1.0.1 at /teams2/, Marshall Platform with Agent changes paused, Marshall Canvas staged. Verification: 74 PHP files via PHP 8 AST parser, node --check all JS, per-ZIP SHA-256. A Marshall-to-FAC HTMX filter argument mismatch was caught at activation.
- HTMX v4 note (2026-08-10): upstream status as-of-Aug-9-2026 = 2.0.10 stable, 4.0.0-beta6; beta6 draws: hx-multipart streaming parts with per-part HX-* headers, Navigation-API scroll restoration, hx-live perf. FAC staging-lane interest only.
- Infra-overhaul plan v2 (cloud-first): IONOS, Docker mentioned, identity/membership portal, DocuSeal waivers, 'Ask the Herald' semi-agentic Q&A. Governance-center build guide (2026-08-24, 55k chars) is the largest single website-track doc: PHP 8 / Apache / MySQL-MariaDB stack references, HTMX 2 integration.
- Content workflow guide (docx-derived) exists for non-dev editors.

## 5. Live cross-check (owner-facing; external to the vault)

GET https://flarmored.org (2026-09-12T20:26Z): HTTP/2 200, server Apache, generator 'WordPress 7.1'. Active theme is STILL hello-elementor with Elementor assets present; loaded plugins visible on home page: fac-events, fac-events-chronicle, fac-homepage, fac-platform-core, marshall-platform; htmx-2.0.10.min.js served; REST namespaces exposed: fac/v1, fac/v2, fac/v3, fac-creator/v2, marshall/v1 (+ application-passwords auth advertised).
Reading: the 2026-08-13 COMPOSITE path (FAC Platform Core 0.1.1 + Marshall) is what shipped to production, not the standalone fac-native theme package from 2026-08-11; Elementor removal is still in progress (presentation plugins retired from the request path per the composite notes, theme swap pending). HTMX 2.0.10 matches the pinned-stable policy exactly - the FHAS pin is being honored in prod. The fac/v1..v3 + fac-creator/v2 surfaces confirm the fighter-creator/composite builds are live.

## 6. Assessment-layer observations

assess_vault bounded summary: 1842 assessable notes, averageOverall 0.359 - the vault-wide center of mass is 'weakly-supported'. Dominant diagnostic family: GKX-PROVENANCE-001 (no source_refs declared) with provenance_quality=0 dragging composites; weights put 0.4 combined on provenance+evidence, so the cheapest vault-wide quality lever is source-ref frontmatter adoption, not prose edits. Relationship integrity generally scores well where edges exist, but lineageEdges=8 vs semanticEdges=5468 means supersession is barely used; 391 unresolved links.

## 7. Tool-experience critique (honest, per standing preference)

What worked: search->get_note->get_related->get_lineage chain is fast and the origin-separated envelopes are genuinely useful; graphiti pagination is solid; error text is mostly clean. What cost me: (1) F-A param-name surprise (at vs time) burned one session-kill because the exception surfaced as an ExceptionGroup at teardown - consistent with my skill's warning, and still the single worst DX trap in the API; (2) F-B's 'not found' phrasing sent me looking for a missing cache rather than a missing selector; (3) get_note on type=note files returns uid=None even when the note is fully assessed elsewhere - two identity surfaces (file: id vs uuid) that don't cross over cleanly; (4) agent_name is display-only across tools - fine, but it appears in schema descriptions with examples ('Codex Game Research') that prime users toward per-agent semantics that don't exist. None of these are correctness bugs; all four are cheap doc/ergonomics wins for the claude docs lane.

Summary for disposition: F-A/F-B/F-C are kosmos-oden server-side items (owner + claude/codex lanes), F-D is a source-note typo (owner), §5 confirms the website program is mid-transition with the composite build live. Fixture scripts for every F-item repro available on request (drivers in /tmp on agentJ-008-507).
payload.subject: FINDING: kosmos-oden v0.8.3 deep assessment (18-tool exercise) + FAC website-tech survey from vault + live flarmored.org cross-check
